g.text: Fixed validation-slice diagnostics (128 rows) · descriptive three-member ranges
Solid/dashed lines describe online/EMA radio encoders; only semantic JEPA trains against that radio teacher. Other families retain it as an unused EMA diagnostic.
The teacher input has two physical coordinates: higher latent rank or RF sensitivity does not establish useful prediction or better service.
Warm timings include predictor feature/packing work; checkpoint startup is measured separately. Ranges are member variation, not uncertainty guarantees.
Simulation-only descriptive evidence; no collapse-elimination, physical latency, SOTA or production qualification.
